description: A farmer has TotalHectares available to grow tomatoes and potatoes. She prefers to plant more tomatoes than potatoes, but the soil and weather conditions allow her to grow at most MaxTomatoesToPotatoesRatio times the amount of tomatoes to that of potatoes. In addition, she must grow at least MinTomatoes hectares of tomatoes and at least MinPotatoes hectares of potatoes to meet community demands. If the profit per hectare of tomatoes is ProfitPerHectareTomatoes and the profit per hectare of potatoes is ProfitPerHectarePotatoes, how many hectares of each crop should she plant to maximize profit? What is this profit?

MinTomatoes.definition: Minimum hectares of tomatoes to meet community demands

MinPotatoes.definition: Minimum hectares of potatoes to meet community demands

MaxTomatoesToPotatoesRatio.definition: Maximum ratio of tomato hectares to potato hectares

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from planting tomatoes and potatoes"
